name: placed-frames
title: Placed Frames
claim: A pi agent's tool calls go to Daytona and Modal sandboxes, and Jev places each one on the sandbox that fits it.

oneOf.why: An OpenAI-compatible gateway that serves the lead under its public id and passes TypeSafe through at /typesafe/v1, instead of a Gemini key.
oneOf.where: your gateway's base URL, ending in /v1

keys.why: A key for the lead: Gemini's own, or a gateway's.
The daytona environment: Daytona sandboxes, made through Daytona's REST API.
A Daytona snapshot with node, when your organization's default sandbox has none.
The modal environment: Modal sandboxes, through the modal SDK (npm install --no-save modal@0.11.0).
The secret of that Modal token.
Jev at TypeSafe, which places each frame.
Another address for TypeSafe's API, when you reach it through a proxy of your own.

programs.why: runs the demo here, and the tile program in each sandbox

environments.purpose: A small sandbox for light work: wide views of the zoom, at few iterations per pixel.
A sandbox with two CPUs for heavy work: deep views of the zoom, at many iterations per pixel.

input.shape: examples/placed-frames/job.ts, Input: how many frames the zoom has
